subject: MAP draft + reforecast — HealthBridge
messages:
From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Taylor <staylor@healthbridge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Mar 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP draft + next steps — HealthBridge

Hi Sam —

Great to meet today — thanks for a thorough discovery call. Per our conversation I attached a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to align milestones, owners, and a target close date. High-level summary: 

- Goal: Production pilot of Redwood inference for HealthBridge clinical workflows
- Proposed target close: 2026-06-30 (initial plan)
- Key milestones (draft):
  • Technical deep-dive / integration plan (owner: Redwood + HealthBridge Eng) — target: 2026-03-18
  • Security & compliance evidence review (owner: HealthBridge / Redwood) — target: 2026-04-15
  • Procurement & Legal (owner: HealthBridge) — target: 2026-05-01
  • Pilot start (owner: HealthBridge / Redwood) — target: 2026-06-01

Ask: please review the attached MAP (HealthBridge_MAP_v1.xlsx) and confirm: (1) owners listed on your side, (2) any dependencies we missed, and (3) whether the target close date looks feasible.

I also linked the HubSpot deal and a shared folder for artifacts: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/78910 and https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cHealthBridge-MAP

Next steps from our side: we will hold the technical deep-dive but can adjust dates if your procurement timeline needs more runway.

Thanks —
Connor O'Brien
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0192
Attachment: HealthBridge_MAP_v1.xlsx (xlsx spreadsheet, 1 sheet)

From: Sam Taylor <staylor@healthbridge.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya@healthbridge.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 09:24:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP draft + next steps — HealthBridge

Connor —

Appreciate the MAP and the clear rundown. Quick update from our side: leadership has reprioritized vendor integrations for Q2 and is pushing most procurement actions into late Q2 / early Q3 to align with our fiscal review. That means the target close will likely slip — please consider this a reforecast. Proposed new dates on our side:

- Security & compliance evidence review — moved to 2026-05-15 (dependency: internal security team availability)
- Procurement kickoff — moved to 2026-05-01 (we will confirm exact procurement owner next week)
- Pilot start — moved to 2026-07-15
- New target close — 2026-08-15

We also have an outstanding security questionnaire and a few additional evidence asks. I'm attaching the questionnaire (healthbridge-security-questions.pdf). Can Redwood provide SOC 2 report and an engineer for the deep-dive on the new proposed dates?

Quote: "On Sun, 1 Mar 2026 at 16:12, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com> wrote:"
> Great to meet today — thanks for a thorough discovery call. Per our conversation I attached a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to align milestones, owners, and a target close date.

Thanks,
Sam Taylor
Director of Product Integrations | HealthBridge
staylor@healthbridge.com
Attachment: healthbridge-security-questions.pdf (PDF, 6 pages)

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 7 Mar 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: MAP update — HealthBridge (timeline shift + security asks)

Team —

Forwarding Sam's update. HealthBridge has asked to push the close to ~2026-08-15 and bumped security/compliance review to mid-May. Things for our side:

1) Marissa — can you update the MAP (switch pilot -> 2026-07-15, procurement kickoff 2026-05-01, new target close 2026-08-15) and send back a v2 to Sam? Mark Redwood owners for technical deep-dive and SOC2 delivery.
2) Stephanie — can you assemble our SOC2 package and a short compliance cover note (we should include the SOC2 letter + controls summary)? Also confirm an engineer for the technical deep-dive on proposed week of 3/15 or 3/18 (Sam mentioned 3/18 originally; they may need to rebook).
3) Lauren — heads up on the adjusted close; may need to adjust any proposed commercial cadence or discounts tied to Q2 delivery.

I'll own communications and update HubSpot deal HB-2026-0483.

Thanks —
Connor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachment: (forwarded) healthbridge-security-questions.pdf

- Technical deep-dive / integration plan (owner: Redwood Eng / HealthBridge Eng) — confirmed: 2026-03-18 (Connor to send calendar invite once you confirm availability)
- Security & compliance evidence review (owner: HealthBridge / Redwood) — moved to 2026-05-15 (Redwood to provide SOC2 report + controls summary)
- Procurement kickoff (owner: HealthBridge) — 2026-05-01 (please confirm procurement contact)
- Pilot start (owner: HealthBridge / Redwood) — 2026-07-15
- Target close — 2026-08-15

Action items:
1) Connor (Redwood) — send calendar invite for 3/18 technical deep-dive and upload MAP v2 to shared folder.
2) Marissa (Redwood) — confirm Redwood owners in MAP v2 and update HubSpot.
3) Stephanie (Redwood) — upload SOC2 package to the shared folder and drop a one-page compliance note.
4) Sam (HealthBridge) — confirm procurement owner and availability for 3/18 deep-dive.

Best,
